english.title: Fail to clean house depopulated of conventionally reared meat chickens - Wales
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, were responsible for conventionally reared meat chickens at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) when, after the final depopulation of a house and before a new flock had been introduced,

(A)_[all parts of the house, and any equipment or utensil which had been in contact with chickens, were not thoroughly cleaned and disinfected in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)]_
(B)_[all litter was not removed and clean litter not provided]_
(C)_[all parts of the house, and any equipment or utensil which had been in contact with chickens, were not thoroughly cleaned and disinfected and all litter was not removed and clean litter not provided in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(1)(ba), 7(1)(a) and 9 of, and paragraph 12 of Schedule 5A to, the Welfare of Farmed Animals (Wales) Regulations 2007.

other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
